theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_smooth_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (W : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen W → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f W → ∀ LW : ℝ≥0, (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl P)), x ∈ W → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖₊ ≤ LW) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, |g x - f x| ≤ δ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖₊ ≤ LW)
